# Real recordings

Listening tests recorded on a real piano with the app (Listening check → "Record a listening
test"), shared by the project owner for use as regression tests.

- `ipad-easy-2026-09-28.wav` / `.json`: iPad microphone, acoustic piano at home, the easy
  listening test (`listening-test-v2-easy`, wait mode). 48 kHz mono, 41.8 s, quiet (piano about
  −51 dBFS). The JSON lists every note asked for with the time it was played on the recording's
  timeline (`expected[].t`) and what the listener heard live.
